tools.name: search_discoveries
tools.description: Find scientific discoveries by words in the title, field, organization, AI technology or summary. Terms match the start of a word, fold plurals and word endings, ignore accents and British/American spelling, and expand common abbreviations (LLM, ML) and variants (Nasca/Nazca, Herculaneum/Ercolano).

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List the catalog fields (for the search_discoveries field filter) with their record counts.

tools.name: get_discovery
tools.description: Retrieve a public scientific discovery by its stable ID, including its original source, summary, evidence and caveats.

tools.name: search_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Find publicly disclosed software vulnerabilities whose discovery involved AI, a collection kept separate from the scientific catalog. tools.name: get_vulnerability
tools.description: Retrieve an AI-found vulnerability case by its stable ID, including the AI role, sources, CVSS, impacts, remediation and source-attributed caveats.
